_meta.purpose: Researched replacement for the hand-authored factors in PROTOCOLS. Every claim carries a source and an assessment date so staleness is visible rather than invisible.
_meta.assessed_by: web research, cross-checked across at least two independent sources per funding claim
_meta.schema_note: class decides which ranking a protocol belongs in. The old model scored all three classes on one scale, which is why a live $1.29B token ranked second in an airdrop tracker.

classes.pre_token_open: No token yet, and an entry window Garry can still act on. The only class that belongs in the main ranking.
classes.pre_token_closed: No token yet, but eligibility is already determined and he is not in it. Worth zero to him however strong the protocol.
classes.token_live: Token already issued and trading. Any ongoing rewards are capital-at-risk yield farming, not airdrop farming. Belongs in a separate view or not at all.
